jobs.jdHtml:
WE'RE HIRING | Fintech Cloud Private Limited
Manager – Legal Documentation & Transaction Coordination (BFSI)
📍 Location: Mumbai
💼 Experience: 4–7 Years
🕒 Employment Type: Full-time
🚀 Joining: Immediate / 15–30 Days
ABOUT THE ROLE
Fintech Cloud is looking for a highly organised, execution-oriented professional to manage the end-to-end legal documentation and transaction coordination process for investor funding, Inter-Corporate Deposits (ICDs), NBFC financing, corporate lending and other financial partnerships.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in drafting and managing financial agreements, coordinating with counterparties and ensuring timely execution and closure of transactions.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Independently draft, review, modify and finalise financial agreements, including Investment Agreements, ICD Agreements, Loan and Funding Agreements, MOUs, NDAs and Corporate Guarantees.
• Coordinate with investors, NBFCs, lenders, corporates and external legal counsels for documentation and transaction closures.
• Manage KYC documentation, board resolutions, corporate authorisations, authorised signatory details and execution formalities.
• Maintain centralised agreement trackers covering counterparties, agreement values, execution status, expiry dates, renewals and pending approvals.
• Ensure accuracy of commercial terms, document version control and proper maintenance of executed agreements.
• Drive timely follow-ups and closures while escalating complex legal, regulatory and compliance matters to the relevant teams.
CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
• 4–7 years of relevant experience in NBFCs, fintech, lending companies, corporate lending or BFSI.
• Hands-on experience in ICD agreements, NBFC funding arrangements, corporate lending documentation or investor funding transactions.
• Qualified Company Secretary (CS) preferred.
• LLB candidates are also welcome. B.Com and MBA Finance candidates with substantial financial documentation experience will be considered.
• Strong drafting, proofreading and documentation management skills.
• Proficiency in MS Word (Track Changes, Document Comparison) and Excel.
• Strong understanding of financial and commercial terms.
• Ability to independently manage multiple transactions with accuracy, confidentiality and ownership.
Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical drafting assessment based on a sample ICD or Funding Agreement.
Preference will be given to Mumbai-based candidates who can join immediately or within 15–30 days.
Interested candidates can apply directly on ilusha.desai@fintechcloud.com
